examples.explanation: The substring s[4..6] == "aaa" satisfies the conditions. It has a length of 3. All characters are the same. The character before "aaa" is 'b', which is different from 'a'. There is no character after "aaa".
There is no substring of length 2 that consists of one distinct character and satisfies the conditions.
